mapper.select: select a.articleNo, a.articleTitle, a.uid, m.name, m.rank from fitian.Article a inner join fitian.Member m on a.uid = m.uid where a.boxCode = #{boxCode} order by a.articleNo desc limit 20
mapper.insert: insert into fitian.Article (uid, articleTitle, articleScript, category, boxCode) value (#{uid},#{articleTitle},#{articleScript},#{category},#{boxCode})
